physics.1: Pressure builds at the crown when you're forced to wait. A short walk or a decisive move breaks it faster than rest ever could.
physics.2: Your crown absorbs noise before you consciously notice it. Eye strain and mental fog are the tell. Find a dim, quiet room before pushing through.
physics.3: Thoughts race here right before sleep. Talking it out, even to no one in particular, empties the head faster than trying to think it still.
physics.4: This crown holds steady until forced into sudden change, then the jaw and scalp tighten. A small planned novelty keeps it from calcifying.
physics.5: Confinement is what wears on this crown. Tension gathers behind the eyes when you've stayed in one place too long. Move your body, move the scene.
physics.6: Unmet obligations sit heaviest here. The forehead tightens under duties you haven't voiced. Handing off one task lifts more than finishing three.
physics.7: Overthinking turns into a literal heaviness at the top of the skull. Oddly, solitude clears it faster than any distraction you could reach for.
physics.8: A clenched jaw is this crown's tell that control is being gripped too hard. Loosen the grip on purpose and the tension follows.
physics.9: Old, unspoken grief settles as weight in the head. Some kind of closure — spoken, written, ritualized — is what actually lifts it.
physics.10: Transitions make this crown spin, literally, as dizziness. Ground the body first; the head follows once the feet feel steady again.
physics.11: This crown is finely tuned and easily overwhelmed by light or sound. Protecting input, not pushing through it, is what preserves its sharpness.
physics.12: Neck stiffness builds during long uncertainty. Even a small, imperfect decision unsticks what indecision has frozen in place.
physics.13: Sudden internal shifts can trigger real vertigo here. Don't fight the disorientation — it resolves on its own once the shift completes.
physics.14: Screen time and overstimulation exhaust this crown fast at either extreme. It wants the middle: alternating real focus with real rest.
physics.15: Under temptation, the scalp tightens and breath goes shallow. Naming the craving out loud does more than trying to override it silently.
physics.16: Unexpected news lands here first, often as a sudden headache. Structure and routine are the ballast this crown reaches for after shock.
physics.17: Daydreaming leaves this crown feeling light and floaty, almost disconnected. A real meal and real rest bring it back down to earth.
physics.18: Foggy thinking here usually means an unnamed fear underneath. Say the fear plainly and the fog lifts faster than any distraction would.
physics.19: Too much attention, even good attention, tires this crown out. A short, quiet withdrawal recharges what constant visibility drains.
physics.20: Clarity can hit like a jolt behind the eyes. Write it down immediately — this crown loses sharp insight fast if it isn't captured.
physics.21: Too many open threads gather as clutter at the crown. Finishing one small thing, not the biggest thing, clears the most space.
physics.22: Information overload scatters this crown's focus quickly. Simplify what's coming in, and the natural big-picture clarity returns on its own.

energy.1: This current wants to lead. It drains fastest while waiting on someone else's move — take the first step yourself to refill it.
energy.2: Quiet and receptive by nature, this energy empties out in loud, crowded spaces. Stillness recharges it faster than sleep does.
energy.3: Bright and quick to scatter, this current fades when ideas stay unspoken. Say the thought out loud and watch it recirculate.
energy.4: Dense and steady, this energy drains hard under sudden unplanned change. One predictable anchor point restores its rhythm.
energy.5: Wide-ranging by design, this current empties fast in confinement. New scenery, even briefly, refills it almost immediately.
energy.6: This energy circles around caretaking and drains when your own needs go unspoken too long. Let someone help you for once.
energy.7: Pulled inward, this current fades in prolonged small talk. Real, extended silence — not distraction — is what brings it back.
energy.8: Forceful and directive, this energy drains the moment control slips away. Reclaim one clear decision and the charge returns.
energy.9: Carrying weight from the past, this current fades when old matters stay open. Letting go, deliberately, refills it more than time alone.
energy.10: Cyclical by nature, this energy stalls when forced into rigid stability. Let it rise and fall — resisting the dip drains it faster.
energy.11: Porous and finely tuned, this current empties quickly in overstimulating spaces. Reduce the input and the charge returns fast.
energy.12: Held in reserve, this energy drains during prolonged indecision. Choosing anything, even imperfectly, releases it from the holding pattern.
energy.13: This current surges through sudden shifts and drains when change is resisted. Let the shift happen and the energy moves again.
energy.14: Seeking constant balance, this energy drains at either extreme — too much rest or too much activity. The middle restores it reliably.
energy.15: Intensifying under pull and desire, this current fades when temptation is suppressed rather than examined honestly.
energy.16: This energy holds tension before release and drains when disruption is denied. Accept the shake-up and it starts flowing again.
energy.17: Floating toward possibility, this current drains when grounded action is skipped entirely. One concrete step restores its traction.
energy.18: This energy dims under unexamined worry, fading fastest when fear stays vague. Naming it specifically brightens the current quickly.
energy.19: Warm and visible, this current drains under prolonged unshared spotlight. Real connection recharges it more than attention alone does.
energy.20: Activating in sudden bursts, this energy fades when insight goes unacted on. Small follow-through is what sustains the charge.
energy.21: Gathering toward closure, this current drains when too many threads stay open. Completing even one thing fully refills it.
energy.22: Spanning many parts at once, this energy drains under fragmented focus. One unifying priority restores its full charge.

emotions.1: You feel most alive here starting something new. Impatience is the first sign it's building. Channel the urgency into one clear move.
emotions.2: Quiet connection is where this feeling comes alive. Watch for overwhelm as the early sign — retreat to calm before it builds further.
emotions.3: Mid-conversation, mid-creation, this feeling peaks. Restlessness signals it's asking for release. Say the thought and it settles.
emotions.4: Steady routine is where this feeling lives comfortably. Anxiety is what tells you it's slipping. Return to something familiar to settle it.
emotions.5: Freedom to roam brings this feeling alive. Restriction is its earliest warning. A change of scene settles it almost instantly.
emotions.6: Caring for others is where this feeling finds purpose. Resentment is the sign it's gone too far. Ask for support before it deepens.
emotions.7: Solitary reflection is this feeling's natural home. Isolation fatigue is what signals it's overdone. One honest conversation settles it fast.
emotions.8: Being in command is where this feeling comes alive. Powerlessness is its warning sign. One decisive step settles it quickly.
emotions.9: This feeling comes alive after real closure. Unspoken grief is its warning sign. Naming the loss directly settles it.
emotions.10: Change is where this feeling thrives. Dread of stagnation signals it's stuck. Starting even one small shift settles it.
emotions.11: Deep perception brings this feeling alive. Overwhelm from input is its earliest sign. Reduce the stimulation and it settles fast.
emotions.12: This feeling comes alive once a decision lands. Suspended waiting is its warning sign. Choosing anything settles it almost instantly.
emotions.13: Transformation is where this feeling peaks. Fear of the unknown signals resistance. Trusting the process is what settles it.
emotions.14: Balance is where this feeling feels right. Overextension is its earliest sign. Returning to moderation settles it reliably.
emotions.15: Acknowledged desire brings this feeling alive. Shame around wanting is its warning sign. Honest naming is what settles it.
emotions.16: This feeling settles once disruption has passed. Shock is its immediate sign. Give the aftermath time to settle on its own.
emotions.17: Hope is where this feeling lives most naturally. Disillusionment is its warning sign. One grounded step settles it quickly.
emotions.18: This feeling comes alive once fear is faced directly. Vague dread is its earliest sign. Naming the fear settles it.
emotions.19: Being seen and celebrated brings this feeling alive. Fear of fading is its warning sign. Genuine recognition settles it.
emotions.20: The moment of realization is where this feeling peaks. Urgency to act is its sign. One small follow-through settles it.
emotions.21: Completion is where this feeling lands fully. Anticipatory anxiety is its earliest sign. Finishing what's started settles it.
emotions.22: Holding the whole picture brings this feeling alive. Scattered overwhelm is its warning sign. Simplifying focus settles it quickly.
